pack_version: ComfyUI-H3-SGLang-Pack 1.0.1 + ToIV patches (sglang>=0.5.19 CustomBlockAdapterSpec compat; sglang UUID patch in multimodal_gen/platforms/cuda.py)。SGLang 路线实测无单卡加速价值，生产加速档位改用原生节点（MiniMaxH3Turbo / MiniMaxH3BlockCacheT8 / SageAttention patch），本文件 2026-09-12 晚改写。
worker_endpoint: none (in-Process ComfyUI :8195 native nodes; SGLang pack runtime available but not recommended on SM120 single GPU)
measured_on: 2026-09-12, workstation GPU2 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell SM120, 1344x768x124f, seed 1101, native 基线: 端到端 879.1s / 去噪 ~515s / 峰值 84.9G; 方法见 bench.md
native_node_signature: MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo(clip, vae, prompt, width=1344, height=768, length=124) -> CONDITIONING, LATENT
BasicGuider(model, conditioning) -> GUIDER ; KSamplerSelect(sampler_name=euler) -> SAMPLER ; BasicScheduler(model, simple, steps, denoise=1.0) -> SIGMAS ; RandomNoise(noise_seed) -> NOISE
SamplerCustomAdvanced(noise, guider, sampler, sigmas, latent_image) -> LATENT
